name: doc7
tagline: Turn any document into AI-ready Markdown with visual understanding
description: doc7 turns PDFs, Office files, scans, screenshots, charts, formulas, and diagrams into AI-ready Markdown through your own OpenAI-compatible multimodal model — no required OCR stack and no document-processing service lock-in. Instead of stopping at character extraction, doc7 reads the whole page with a vision-language model, so tables, formulas, charts, diagram relationships, and UI state all survive as searchable Markdown. In an open benchmark on raster-only pages it recovered 15/15 checked visual facts with a local qwen3.5-9b model, versus 9/15 for MarkItDown with OCR and 3/15 for Docling. The single Go binary provides an interactive CLI, batch and resume processing, an MCP server with a typed convert tool, an async HTTP service, and a Go SDK, with model choice left to you — including private or local deployments for near-zero marginal cost.
highlights: One pipeline converts PDF, Office, scans, charts, formulas, and diagrams into AI-ready Markdown
